verdict.rationale: Polar documents a public HTTP API with versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs ('Polar HTTP and Webhooks API') on its docs site, plus official typed TypeScript and Python SDKs. Specific API surfaces are documented, including Checkout Sessions, Customer State, Events Ingestion, per-call proration and webhook endpoint CRUD, so the product can be driven programmatically end to end. The probe's 404s at conventional root OpenAPI paths do not contradict the docs-hosted specs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working as documented, and spec discoverability at standard well-known paths.
